hero.subtitle: I build interactive web experiences and ship my own projects — from 3D portfolios to full-stack platforms.

box2.title: Beyond the Pixels.
box2.subtitle: A journey through motion, 3D interactions, and high-performance engineering.
box2.text: This portfolio is more than just a simple collection of links. It is a demonstration of what modern web standards can offer in terms of fluidity and performance.

box3.darkText: You are currently viewing the high-precision dark interface, optimized for 3D depth and atmospheric lighting.
box3.lightText: Try switching your device to Dark Mode. Experience the dynamic lighting, fireflies, and the meticulous attention to detail hidden in the shadows.

box4.title: Technical Focus
box4.quote: For this project, I focused heavily on the 3D aspect and animations powered by GSAP.
box4.text: Every movement is orchestrated to react to your scroll, creating a visual narrative between the code and the user.

aboutBox.title: My Journey
aboutBox.text1: I am a developer driven by the desire to merge technical performance with creative aesthetics. My journey is defined by a constant search for new ways to interact with the web.
aboutBox.text2: Beyond just writing code, I focus on the feel of an interface—how it moves, how it reacts, and how it immerses the user. This portfolio is the result of that passion for detail and motion.

box5.title: Extended Portfolio
box5.text: Naturally, this isn't the only project I'm working on. To see my other works, what better way than to visit the page dedicated to them?

box6.title: Let's Connect
box6.text: I would be very happy to receive your feedback or inquiries. Here, you will find everything you need to reach out. Please don't hesitate to leave a message or an email; I will personally ensure a response.
